intro: Explore Málaga city on the Costa del Sol: the Alcazaba, Roman Theatre, Picasso Museum, historic streets, lively harbour and beaches. Plan your days and keep favourite places, memorable visits and photos on your device.

areas.name: Centro Histórico
areas.description: Walk the pedestrian streets around Calle Larios, Plaza de la Constitución and Málaga Cathedral.

areas.name: La Malagueta
areas.description: City beach neighbourhood close to the harbour and bullring.

areas.name: Soho
areas.description: Creative district known for street art and galleries.

areas.name: Muelle Uno
areas.description: Waterfront shopping, dining and promenades beside the port.

areas.name: Pedregalejo
areas.description: Traditional seafront area known for beach restaurants and grilled fish.

areas.name: El Palo
areas.description: Local coastal neighbourhood east of the centre.

areas.name: Teatinos
areas.description: Residential university district with restaurants and transport connections.

attractions.name: Alcazaba of Málaga
attractions.description: Historic Moorish fortress with city views; check official visiting hours and ticket information.

attractions.name: Roman Theatre
attractions.description: Ancient theatre beside the Alcazaba; check access and exhibitions.

attractions.name: Castillo de Gibralfaro
attractions.description: Hilltop castle with panoramic views; steep uphill access.

attractions.name: Museo Picasso Málaga
attractions.description: Art museum in the historic centre; check exhibitions and booking.

attractions.name: Málaga Cathedral
attractions.description: Landmark cathedral near the old town; check visiting arrangements.

attractions.name: Centre Pompidou Málaga
attractions.description: Art centre by Muelle Uno; check current exhibitions.

transport.name: Málaga Airport
transport.description: Málaga–Costa del Sol Airport serves the city; check airport rail and bus connections.

transport.name: Cercanías C1 train
transport.description: Links Málaga city, the airport, Torremolinos, Benalmádena and Fuengirola; check Renfe timetables.

transport.name: Metro de Málaga
transport.description: Urban metro lines serve parts of the city; check stations and current service.

transport.name: EMT city buses
transport.description: Local bus network serving beaches and neighbourhoods; check current routes.

transport.name: Walking
transport.description: The historic centre is largely pedestrianised; some castle routes are steep.

transport.name: Taxis and ride services
transport.description: Use licensed providers and confirm pickup locations and fares.

useful.name: Currency
useful.description: Euro (€); check bank and card charges.

useful.name: Travel documents
useful.description: Check current UK government Spain travel advice and passport requirements.

useful.name: Language
useful.description: Spanish is the official language; English is widely spoken in tourist areas.

useful.name: Beach safety
useful.description: Follow beach flags, lifeguard advice and weather warnings.

useful.name: Time zone
useful.description: Mainland Spain is generally one hour ahead of the UK.

useful.name: Sun protection
useful.description: Carry drinking water, sunscreen and a hat, especially in summer.

beaches.name: Playa de la Malagueta
beaches.description: Popular central city beach near the port.

beaches.name: Playa de la Caleta
beaches.description: Long sandy stretch east of La Malagueta.

beaches.name: Playa de Pedregalejo
beaches.description: Seafront beach with restaurants and promenade.

beaches.name: Playa de El Palo
beaches.description: Neighbourhood beach known for traditional seafood eateries.

beaches.name: Playa de Huelin
beaches.description: Urban beach west of the port with nearby parks and promenade.

markets.name: Mercado Central de Atarazanas
markets.description: Historic food market with produce and tapas stalls; check trading days.

markets.name: Calle Larios
markets.description: Main shopping street in the historic centre.

markets.name: Muelle Uno
markets.description: Harbour-side shops, dining and seasonal events.

markets.name: Soho galleries and shops
markets.description: Independent creative businesses and street art.

nightlife.name: Plaza de la Merced
nightlife.description: Cafés and evening venues around a lively historic square.

nightlife.name: Historic centre
nightlife.description: Tapas bars and restaurants around the old town.

family.name: Muelle Uno waterfront
family.description: Easy harbour walks and family-friendly dining.

family.name: Parque de Málaga
family.description: Shaded green space near the old town and port.

family.name: La Malagueta beach
family.description: Beach day close to central amenities; follow swimming flags.

family.name: Gibralfaro viewpoints
family.description: City views, though the walk can be steep.

dining.name: Atarazanas market area
dining.description: Fresh produce, small tapas stalls and local food.

dining.name: Pedregalejo
dining.description: Beachside seafood restaurants and espetos (grilled sardines).

dining.name: El Palo
dining.description: Neighbourhood seafood spots and casual dining.

daytrips.name: Nerja
daytrips.description: Coastal town with beaches and viewpoints; check bus options.

daytrips.name: Frigiliana
daytrips.description: Whitewashed hillside village; often combined with Nerja.

daytrips.name: Ronda
daytrips.description: Historic town famous for its gorge and bridge; check rail or bus routes.

daytrips.name: Antequera
daytrips.description: Historic town with dolmens and nearby natural scenery.

daytrips.name: Torremolinos
daytrips.description: Beach resort reachable on the C1 train.

daytrips.name: Fuengirola
daytrips.description: Seafront town accessible by the C1 train.
